
## Install

Download the zip for your OS, unpack it and copy the formats you use. Paths, the macOS quarantine
step and runtime requirements are in [docs/install.md](https://github.com/mr-kaynak/sedef-amp/blob/main/docs/install.md).

| Zip | Contains |
|---|---|
| `SedefAmp-*-macOS.zip` | VST3, AU, CLAP, standalone app (universal: Apple silicon and Intel) |
| `SedefAmp-*-Windows.zip` | VST3, CLAP, standalone app (x64) |
| `SedefAmp-*-Linux.zip` | VST3, CLAP, standalone app (x86_64) |

Builds are not notarized or code-signed with a developer certificate yet.
